cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 82% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.26%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at +0.31%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: HUBB is the standout at +3.52%
cards.body: Leaders: HUBB +3.52%, CCJ +2.42%, UUUU +2.40%, EQNR +1.98%, VRT +1.63%. Laggards: OKLO -0.60%, BEP -0.60%, DUK -0.44%, TRGP -0.28%.
